Active-web proof: session query cancellation/removal, identity and rehydration are local effects; conditional websocket connection belongs to the reused application interface. No session write occurs in these five workspace bodies.

React Query, native URL/Date/Set, injected storage and native worker/IndexedDB providers are explicit interfaces; no descendant recursion. Invalidations can trigger active observers but are not unconditional HTTP sends.
